notes: EntityPlayerMP.onItemPickup sends an S0D (the collected entity, the collector) to every watcher of the collected item, orb or arrow whenever addItemStackToInventory took any of it: a partial take too, whose item stays on the server. Natively collide_with_player_pool records each onItemPickup of the network tick (server_player s0d_ids); the live client's handleCollectItem (play.c drops_after_tick) starts the EntityPickupFX from its copy and takes the copy out of the world at the next client tick. An orb spawned and taken in one row flies from its copy at the S11's raw (undivided) fields. The ClientWorldProbe replay (test_clientworld.c) covers the client half against recorded packets. idx-pickup-s1 (a partial take of a dirt stack, a dev orb) holds the client's items and pickup effects to the oracle client's at every frame.
